evidenceLimitations: Only text plan@0 plus two successful Read calls@1/2 with reverse B/A result completion is captured here; no tool-only reversed layout, mixed tools, error, async, child or more-call evidence.
Only a first automatic boundary is captured. The later ordinary resume ran only after a new public full-R1 ACK; it is not a second dual automatic round.
Mock tool-call input_tokens=190000 and threshold=20 are controlled triggers, not real provider billing or a natural trigger threshold.
The configured endpoint is fake-key loopback and fresh HOME/config/workspace were empty. No OS egress firewall was applied; this does not establish absence of every possible background connection.
Selected requests omit SDK system/tool schema and unrelated reminders. Full wire and original authority remain only in the recorded temporary capture directory.

The summary request did not include current Read calls/results; the first post-summary final request did include both results in B/A order plus the exact persisted summary. This is a model-context fact, not an admission rule.
